subject: Validation runbook + final handoff criteria — Novacare POC
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novacare.com>, Novacare Procurement <procurement@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Validation runbook + final handoff criteria — Novacare POC

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised I attached a first-draft validation runbook and a short acceptance vector set to make the POC signoff unambiguous. High-level asks here: please review and confirm by Friday so we can lock the MAP and shipping dates.

Summary (one-page):
- Goal: Demonstrate production-grade inference for Novacare triage assistant across 10k daily requests pattern while meeting latency SLOs.
- Success signals (must pass all): accuracy >= 88% on the sample set; 95th percentile latency < 350ms; no user-facing hallucinations in red-team sampling (0 critical).
- Exit gates: functional test pass, security questionnaire completed, sample token-cost within agreed band.
- Acceptance tests: 30 representative prompts (attached), 3 soak runs at peak QPS, model rollback criteria defined.
- Owners & timeline: Novacare validation (Samira) to sign off dry-run by 2026-05-22; Redwood engineering (Marissa) to run soak and instrumentation 2026-05-23 — 05-24. Cutover window target: 2026-05-27.

Attachments: validation_runbook_v1.xlsx (runs & test matrix), acceptance-test-vectors.csv (30 prompts).

Questions for you:
1) Any changes to the success thresholds above?
2) Who will be the official Novacare signatory for the exit gate checklist?
3) Are there any procurement/legal approvals that should be on the critical path before 05-27?

If you prefer, I can translate these items into a mutual action plan in HubSpot so we have task owners and deadlines tracked.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of B2B Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
(e) evelyn.hart@redwood.com | (p) +1-415-555-0162
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novacare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Novacare Procurement <procurement@novacare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Validation runbook + final handoff criteria — Novacare POC

Evelyn — thanks for the clear doc. Quick feedback from our side after an initial pass:

- Thresholds: accuracy target is fine but can we call it "weighted intent concordance >= 88%" to account for class imbalance in our triage set?
- Latency: 350ms p95 is optimistic in our environment — can we allow a p95 of 400ms with a plan to optimize to 350ms within two weeks post-cutover?
- Signatory: procurement will own contractual signoff for exit gate #2 (Procurement Signoff) but clinical QA needs to be the clinical tie-off (Dr. Ruiz will be the named approver). I'll loop them in once we finalize test vectors.
- Procurement/Legal: procurement has one outstanding data-flow question (on logging retention). They flagged it but it shouldn't block the cutover if we provide a short-term retention contract note by 05-25.

We can do the dry-run by 05-22 as proposed. Please do convert to a MAP in HubSpot so tasks are visible. Marissa — can your team schedule the soak runs and share runbooks?

Samira
Samira Khan
VP Product, Novacare
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novacare.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Validation runbook + final handoff criteria — Novacare POC

Samira / team —

Thanks — noted on the weighted concordance metric and the latency concession. Updated plan and owners below:

Action items (MAP delta):
- TASK 1 (Novacare) — Finalize clinical approver: Dr. Ruiz (owner: Samira) — due 2026-05-21 EOD.
- TASK 2 (Redwood Eng) — Run three soak windows at peak QPS, capture p50/p95/p99 and token-cost delta: owner Marissa — run 2026-05-23 02:00–08:00 PDT. Deliverable: soak-report.pdf.
- TASK 3 (Redwood SRE) — Instrument prefix/KV cache and enable tracing hooks for the run: owner Karthik — complete by 2026-05-22 17:00 PDT.
- TASK 4 (Novacare Procurement) — Confirm temporary retention note re: logs, or provide wording to be appended to contract: owner procurement@novacare.com — due 2026-05-25.
- TASK 5 (Mutual) — Final signoff call and checklist validation: scheduled 2026-05-25 14:00 PDT.

Acceptance tests (concrete):
- Run A: 30-vector functional pass (weighted concordance >= 88%).
- Run B: Soak run 1 — peak QPS with observability on (no critical faults).
- Run C: Soak run 2 — rollback simulation: induce degraded backend and verify automatic fallback triggers.

Attachments: I uploaded the soak schedule and runbook to the drive link (see thread metadata). We'll produce the soak-report and attach it to the MAP record.

If procurement/legal still needs a minor contract note for retention, we can include a short-term addendum that expires after the POC. That should keep the cutover date intact.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Novacare Procurement <procurement@novacare.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Validation runbook + final handoff criteria — Novacare POC

All — quick update after internal sync: Dr. Ruiz confirmed clinical approver role and procurement provided temporary retention wording this morning. Both items are acceptable.

We ran a short internal dry-run of 10 vectors and the weighted concordance metric is within expectation; procurement is comfortable with the temporary retention addendum.

Novacare confirms the following:
- We accept the weighted concordance >= 88% and accept the p95 latency fallback to 400ms with the two-week optimization commitment.
- Novacare will perform the formal dry-run signoff on 2026-05-22; procurement will provide final wording for the contract addendum by 2026-05-25 (delivered).
- We are green to proceed with the mutual signoff call on 2026-05-25 14:00 PDT and keep 2026-05-27 as the target cutover.

Please convert the thread items into HubSpot MAP tasks and add the soak-report under the MAP record after the run. Thanks for the fast turn.

Samira
Samira Khan
VP Product, Novacare
